edition.title: Data Infra What's New

preheader.en: Langfuse V4 developer experience, DataHub Agent Kafka flows, and smarter RAM alerts — the latest Data Infrastructure product updates.
preheader.zh: Langfuse V4 开发体验、DataHub Agent Kafka 流程、更聪明的 RAM 告警 — Data Infra 最新产品更新。

en: Welcome to the latest edition of the Data Infra Monthly Newsletter!

This month’s highlights center around three themes: #AnalyzeSmarter, #BuildFaster, and #OperateWithConfidence. From Diana 2.8’s more scalable and connected analytics experience to expanded CLI and DataHub Agent capabilities, faster Langfuse performance, and more reliable resource alerts, these updates are designed to simplify data workflows, accelerate development, and help teams operate with greater efficiency and confidence.
zh: 欢迎阅读最新一期《Data Infra 月度通讯》！
本月更新围绕三大主题展开：#AnalyzeSmarter、#BuildFaster 和 #OperateWithConfidence。从 Diana 2.8 更具扩展性、连接性的分析体验，到持续增强的 CLI 与 DataHub Agent 能力，再到更高效的 Langfuse 性能和更可靠的资源告警，这些更新旨在简化数据工作流程、加速开发，并帮助团队更高效、更有信心地开展工作。

en.title: RAM: Alert Improvements
en.subtitle: Three changes to HDFS alerts, plus Seatalk private-bot delivery for every alert type.

features.name: Separate Storage and File Count usage alert
features.desc_source: Storage usage and file-count usage are now alerted separately.

features.name: Implement a mechanism for multiple consecutive rounds of detection to reduce the false alarm rate
features.desc_source: An alert now requires several consecutive detection rounds, reducing the false alarm rate.

features.name: Supports configuring allowed notification times for different channels.
features.desc_source: Configure the time windows in which each notification channel is allowed to send alerts.

features.name: For all alert type, support Seatalk private bot message to receive the alert.
features.desc_source: Alerts of every type can now be received via Seatalk private bot message.

zh.title: RAM：告警优化
zh.subtitle: HDFS 告警的三项改动，加上所有告警类型支持 Seatalk 私信机器人。

features.name: 存储用量与文件数用量告警拆分
features.desc_source: 存储空间用量与文件数用量现在分别告警。

features.name: 连续多轮检测机制
features.desc_source: 需连续多轮检测到才触发告警，降低误报率。

features.name: 各渠道可设置允许通知时间段
features.desc_source: 为不同通知渠道设置允许发送告警的时间。

features.name: Seatalk 私信机器人
features.desc_source: 所有类型的告警都可通过 Seatalk 私信机器人接收。

products.name: DI CLI V1.2

en.title: DI CLI V1.2
en.subtitle: SLA lookups, Kafka topic requests, resource governance and more ingestion task types — from your terminal.

features.name: SLA Instance Info Lookup
features.desc: The CLI now supports detailed SLA instance lookups, including instance status, completion time, slowest path, target task instances, etc. Based on this information, your personal Agent can analyze bottlenecks and provide optimization suggestions.

features.name: Kafka Topic Request Management
features.desc: Submit and track Kafka permission, bandwidth quota and retention size adjustment requests.

features.name: Resource Governance Integration
bullets: Get the details for HDFS assets and Presto/Batch YARN governance tasks via CLI.
Explore non-Hive downstreams of a Hive table via CLI.

features.name: Expanded DataHub Task Management
features.desc: Users can create, operate, and maintain ingestion task types through the CLI, including:

features.name: Interactive and Batch Support for Non-SQL Spark Workloads (Shortcut Commands)
features.desc: Expanded support includes +sql batch mode and interactive and batch shortcut commands for +python and +scala. Shortcut commands combine multiple operations into a single command.

features.name: Graph Management
features.desc: Key updates focus on creating, updating, and safely deleting graph spaces and vertex/edge models.

features.name: Others
bullets: DataMap Enhancement: Task Information Search & Ask — ask about tasks whose outputs or targets are directly associated with a specific Hive table, including task code, status, owner, etc.
Data Service API Creation & Configuration — create Data Service APIs from verified Presto/ClickHouse SQL via CLI, configure API settings, and receive an API identifier for external or Portal access.

zh.title: DI CLI V1.2
zh.subtitle: SLA 查询、Kafka topic 申请、资源治理与更多接入任务类型，都在终端完成。

features.name: SLA 实例信息查询
features.desc: CLI 现支持详细的 SLA 实例查询，包括实例状态、完成时间、最慢路径、目标任务实例等。基于这些信息，你的个人 Agent 可以分析瓶颈并给出优化建议。

features.name: Kafka Topic 申请管理
features.desc: 提交并跟踪 Kafka 权限、带宽配额和保留大小的调整申请。

features.name: 资源治理集成
bullets: 通过 CLI 获取 HDFS 资产以及 Presto/Batch YARN 治理任务的详情。
通过 CLI 探索 Hive 表的非 Hive 下游。

features.name: 扩展 DataHub 任务管理
features.desc: 用户可通过 CLI 创建、运维接入任务，类型包括：

features.name: 非 SQL Spark 工作负载的交互与批处理支持（快捷命令）
features.desc: 新增 +sql 批处理模式，以及 +python 与 +scala 的交互式和批处理快捷命令。快捷命令把多个操作合并为一条命令。

features.name: 图管理
features.desc: 重点更新为图空间及点/边模型的创建、更新与安全删除。

features.name: 其他
bullets: DataMap 增强：任务信息搜索与问答 — 查询输出或目标直接关联到指定 Hive 表的任务，包括任务代码、状态、负责人等。
Data Service API 创建与配置 — 通过 CLI 基于已验证的 Presto/ClickHouse SQL 创建 Data Service API、配置 API 设置，并获得可供外部或 Portal 访问的 API 标识。

products.name: Diana 2.8

en.title: Diana 2.8
en.subtitle: Scalable data delivery, smarter cross-topic analysis, and seamless collaboration

features.name: Scalable Data Export
features.desc: Diana now allows users to export Query Step results to CSV, Excel, or Google Sheets. Large datasets are processed through reusable snapshots and recoverable background tasks, with clear row limits, truncation notices, and permission checks.

features.name: Intelligent Cross-Topic Routing
features.desc: Topic Router determines whether a question can be answered within the current Topic or requires additional Topics. Users can review and confirm the proposed scope before execution, while @ Topic provides a structured way to search for and reference accessible Topics.

features.name: Shareable Report Follow-up Sessions
features.desc: Follow-up conversations created through “Continue in Chat” are now treated as standard Chat Sessions. Owners can share them through the existing Session Share flow, while recipients can securely view the complete conversation history in read-only mode.

zh.title: Diana 2.8
zh.subtitle: 可扩展的数据交付、更智能的跨主题分析，以及无缝协作

features.name: 可扩展的数据导出
features.desc: Diana 现支持将 Query Step 结果导出为 CSV、Excel 或 Google Sheet。大规模数据通过可复用快照和可恢复的后台任务处理，并明确展示行数限制、截断原因及权限校验结果。

features.name: 智能跨 Topic 路由
features.desc: Topic Router 会判断问题能否由当前 Topic 回答，或是否需要补充其他 Topic。系统执行查询前，用户可以查看并确认建议范围；同时可通过 @ Topic 搜索和引用有权限访问的 Topic。

features.name: 可分享的 Report 追问会话
features.desc: 通过“Continue in Chat”产生的 Report 追问会话现在会作为标准 Chat Session 处理。Owner 可沿用现有 Session Share 流程进行分享，被分享者则可以安全地以只读方式查看完整的追问历史。
